notice: Internal planning and control artifact. It prepares a future independent evaluation. It is not an evaluation, a simulation of one, a validation, or a release authorization.

CURRENT_IMPLEMENTATION.treatment: Verified from current source and tests

items.description: Local Engine candidate 0.5.0-local.1 with a deterministic mock adapter only; no provider adapter exists.
Development-material registry (94 texts) and contamination screen.
Local reviewer workspace for candidate packets (offline, synthetic fixtures only).
Frozen synthetic demonstration package, status DEMO_PREPARATION_COMPLETE_NOT_RELEASED.
Release-gate record and validator; every gate open.
Methodology correspondence register: no Engine-to-Codebook correspondence approved.
This package: readiness registries, intake validator, separated review workspaces, run ledger, repository scan and verifier.

An owner-opened intake of a genuinely independent, completed, rights-cleared set of supplier-access exception records, held outside this repository and identified here only by digest and external reference.
Blinded human review by independent reviewers under a frozen Codebook revision, in four separated workspaces: extraction, interpretation, comparison and adjudication.
Engine candidate output produced only under a separately authorized run and compared only in the comparison workspace, with no condition correspondence asserted for candidate keys.
Calibration and agreement analysis under a protocol frozen before any data is seen; none is designed or implemented here.
Every run bound in the readiness registry and every artifact recorded in the append-only run ledger.
Engine-candidate fixtures, regression, corpus and confirmation sets (89 texts).
Frozen synthetic demonstration corpus FD-01 to FD-05.
Synthetic test tokens and probes of this package; they carry no record content.

SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE.rule: No synthetic fixture is independent evaluation evidence, holdout material, a user record or a production sample, whatever it is called.

items.attestation: Authority and rights to use each evaluation record for this purpose
Each record is completed, and its completion status is attested by the record custodian
Chain of custody from source to the evaluation store
Each reviewer is independent of the candidate author and has no conflict
Codebook revision frozen for the evaluation
Interpretation, calibration and adjudication protocols frozen before data is seen

questions_for_counsel: Lawful basis, consent and confidentiality terms for using real supplier-access exception records in an evaluation.
Data-protection obligations for the evaluation store, reviewer access, retention and deletion.
Rights in reviewer contributions and in evaluation results.
What may lawfully be said about any future evaluation result.

limitations.not_an_evaluation: No evaluation has been run, simulated or approximated. No record, reviewer, label, agreement or result exists.
limitations.no_independent_evidence: Independent evaluation evidence is NOT_PRESENT. Nothing in the repository is, or can be relabeled as, such evidence.
limitations.digest_not_independence: Digest matching is a contamination control. A digest that matches no development text does not show that a record is independent.
limitations.no_validation: Nothing here shows the Engine or JRS is valid, reliable or accurate, on any record.
limitations.no_release_effect: No release gate is advanced, and every gate status is unchanged.
limitations.no_counsel_or_owner_action: No counsel determination, owner authorization, reviewer attestation or independent QA exists; the package only names where each is required.
limitations.no_scoring: No DRR score, agreement statistic or classification is computed, and no code for one exists.
limitations.scope_limited: Completed, non-HR supplier-access exception records only. Every other decision domain is refused.
